Title: Azure AD activity logs integration with Azure Monitor Diagnostics and Azure Log Analytics is in public preview

Body.Content: Azure AD activity logs gain long-term retention via an Azure  storage account and can be streamed to a SIEM tool without writing or maintaining any custom scripts.  Unlock usage and security insights from user activity through an external or custom solution, or save time by directly integrating with Azure Log Anlystics dashboards without leaving the Azure portal.
